text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few months have passed since the discovery of that hidden hot spring.
Yukoma Hot Spring Village was bustling with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
The detailed component analysis is complete.
As expected, it has an entirely new spring quality,
quite different from conventional hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my!
And what might those intriguing effects be...?"

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, it was an 'all-purpose cure'♪
Rough skin, stiff shoulders, chronic fatigue.
Even post-injury and illness recovery...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: The minerals condensed deep underground for so many years seem like they'll work wonders.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
All the necessary permits have been cleared.
Starting today, we begin full-scale excavation!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice, yeah♪
An' once the new bath is built...!
We can kick back an' relax again.

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
Um, will we finally be able to enter
that legendary hidden hot spring they showed on the news?

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text:
It's supposed to work wonders, right?
Ah, I want to get in quickly!
My rheumatism has been acting up terribly, you see...!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Please look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, our buzz is skyrocketing, too!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's keep this momentum going
and hype things up even more!
